name: El Gallito Bakery
address: 1551 SW 27th Ave, Miami, FL 33145, United States

reviewSamples.author: Felix Chavarria
reviewSamples.text: El Gallito Bakery is one of those places I cannot recommend enough. I went to this location for years while living in Miami, and it never once disappointed when it came to the quality of the food.

reviewSamples.author: J B
reviewSamples.text: I love this place! Never disappoints! The food is always, always fresh and the lovely ladies who work behind the counter are the best servers I ever had in any bakery in Miami.

reviewSamples.author: TumblrWeed
reviewSamples.text: Best pastelitos I have had in Miami in a long time. Guava, croquetas de jamon, y bocaditos de lazca were all amazing. One thing I will say I wish the cheese pastelito had the sugar crystals on top like other bakeries do but overall amazing food.

reviewSamples.author: Carlos
reviewSamples.text: One of the best Cuban bakeries in Miami. I go at least 3x per week for breakfast. Dont miss out on the pastelito de queso y coco.

reviewSamples.author: V.
reviewSamples.text: Best Cuban bread is here! Their corn bread loaf is so good. Just tried their Butter Cuban Bread, so good, had to get both. Pastries and cakes are beautiful and delicious. Their mini ham and cheese sandwich are great for snacking.
